```yaml
name: Performance Benchmark

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: perf-benchmark-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PR branch
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          path: pr-checkout
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Checkout main branch
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          ref: main
          path: main-checkout
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@395ad3262231945c25e8478fd5baf05154b1d79f # v6.1.0
        with:
          node-version-file: .tool-versions
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: |
            package-lock.json
            pr-checkout/package-lock.json
            main-checkout/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies and build PR branch
        working-directory: pr-checkout
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run build

      - name: Install dependencies and build main branch
        working-directory: main-checkout
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run build

      - name: Run benchmark
        id: benchmark
        run: |
          set -e

          # Function to measure execution time
          measure_time() {
            local dir="$1"
            local runs="$2"
            local warmup_runs="$3"
            
            # Run warmup runs
            for (( i=1; i<=warmup_runs; i++ )); do
              echo "Running warmup run $i..."
              cd "$dir"
              time -f "%e" npm run repomix -- --include 'src,tests' 2>&1 > /dev/null
            done
            
            # Collect measured runs
            times=()
            for (( i=1; i<=runs; i++ )); do
              echo "Running measurement run $i..."
              cd "$dir"
              duration=$(time -f "%e" npm run repomix -- --include 'src,tests' 2>&1 > /dev/null)
              times+=("$duration")
            done
            
            # Calculate median
            sorted_times=($(printf '%s\n' "${times[@]}" | sort -n))
            len=${#sorted_times[@]}
            if (( len % 2 == 1 )); then
              median=${sorted_times[$((len/2))]}
            else
              mid1=${sorted_times[$((len/2-1))]}
              mid2=${sorted_times[$((len/2))]}
              median=$(echo "scale=3; ($mid1 + $mid2) / 2" | bc)
            fi
            
            echo "Median time: $median seconds"
            echo "MEDIAN_TIME=$median" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          }

          # Measure PR branch
          echo "Measuring PR branch..."
          measure_time "pr-checkout" 5 2
          PR_TIME=$MEDIAN_TIME

          # Measure main branch
          echo "Measuring main branch..."
          measure_time "main-checkout" 5 2
          MAIN_TIME=$MEDIAN_TIME

          # Calculate difference
          DIFF_SECONDS=$(echo "scale=3; $PR_TIME - $MAIN_TIME" | bc)
          DIFF_PERCENTAGE=$(echo "scale=2; ($DIFF_SECONDS / $MAIN_TIME) * 100" | bc)

          # Format with sign
          if (( $(echo "$DIFF_SECONDS >= 0" | bc -l) )); then
            DIFF_SECONDS_FORMATTED="+$DIFF_SECONDS"
            DIFF_PERCENTAGE_FORMATTED="+$DIFF_PERCENTAGE"
          else
            DIFF_SECONDS_FORMATTED="$DIFF_SECONDS"
            DIFF_PERCENTAGE_FORMATTED="$DIFF_PERCENTAGE"
          fi

          # Output results
          echo "PR_TIME=$PR_TIME" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "MAIN_TIME=$MAIN_TIME" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "DIFF_SECONDS=$DIFF_SECONDS_FORMATTED" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "DIFF_PERCENTAGE=$DIFF_PERCENTAGE_FORMATTED" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Post benchmark comment
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa # v2.3.0
        with:
          message: |
            ## Performance Benchmark Results
            
            | | Time |
            |---|---:|
            | PR branch | ${{ env.PR_TIME }}s |
            | main branch | ${{ env.MAIN_TIME }}s |
            | **Diff** | **${{ env.DIFF_SECONDS }}s (${{ env.DIFF_PERCENTAGE }}%)** |
            
            *Benchmarked on ${{ github.runner_os }}*
          comment-tag: perf-benchmark-results
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
